[Intro]
[F#m]
I

[Verse 1]
[F#m]met a man locked away For
things he hadn't done
[E]Innocence on a ball and chain He'll
never feel the sun
[F#m]Again on his face or
roses In his hands
[E]but when he smiled At me
I could understand

[Chorus]
[F#m]If you're free you'll
never see the walls
If your head is clear
you'll never free fall
If you're right you'll
never fear the wrong
If your head is high
you'll never fear at all

[Break]
[F#m]
[E]
There

[Verse 2]
[F#m]was a daughter of a man Who
took his life too young She
[E]swore she'd never do the same Then
did just what he'd done
[F#m]And a boy who's gone insane
Voices in his head
[E]No one knows what they say
Now his mother's dead

[Chorus]
[F#m]If you're free you'll
never see the walls
If your head is clear
you'll never free fall
If you're right you'll
never fear the wrong
If your head is high
you'll never fear at all

[Solo]
[F#m]
[E]
[F#m]
[E]
There

[Verse 3]
[F#m]was a man who had a face That
looked a lot like me I
[E]saw him in the mirror and I
fought him in the street
[F#m]And when he turned away I
shot him in the head
[E]Then I came to realize
I had killed myself

[Chorus]
[F#m]If you're free you'll
never see the walls
If your head is clear
you'll never free fall
If you're right you'll
never fear the wrong
If your head is high
you'll never fear
